decisions.rationale: "5q22 deletion" names a chromosomal structural alteration (a genetic event/karyotype finding), not a named disease or disease family, so it is not annotated.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 5 (not a disease mention; describes a biological/genetic process rather than a disease name) and Annotation Rule 1 (Specific Disease requires a disease definition)

decisions.rationale: "familial adenomatous polyposis coli" is a single, well-defined hereditary disease with no further categorization.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease) and 5 (minimum necessary span)

decisions.rationale: Second occurrence of "familial adenomatous polyposis coli" in the abstract; duplicate mentions must be annotated separately.
"FAPC" is the abbreviation/synonym of familial adenomatous polyposis coli and is annotated as its own mention.
"epidermoid cysts" denotes a specific pathological condition with a single definition, reported as a feature of the patients' disease.
"osteomata" refers to a specific benign bone tumour (osteoma); tumour-type terms are retained.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); What NOT to Annotate 4 (cancer and tumor terms are retained)

decisions.rationale: "congenital hypertrophy of the retinal pigment epithelium" is a specific named congenital condition.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease) and 5 (minimum necessary span)

decisions.rationale: "CHRPEs" is the abbreviation of congenital hypertrophy of the retinal pigment epithelium and is annotated as a separate synonymous mention.
"mental handicap" is a broad category of intellectual impairment encompassing many specific conditions, analogous to the grey-area term "mental retardation".
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Disease Class) and Examples 11 (grey-area terms annotated as Disease Class)

decisions.rationale: "interstitial deletion of the long arm of chromosome 5" describes a cytogenetic chromosomal anomaly rather than a named disease or disease family; the disease itself is familial adenomatous polyposis coli.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 4 (not a disease name; general descriptive term) and Annotation Rule 1 (Specific Disease requires a disease definition)

decisions.rationale: "microdeletion syndromes" refers to a family of multiple specific recurrent microdeletion diseases rather than one specific disease.
